title: CHG-3570: Change Record For The Support Console
body:
SUMMARY:

The Support Console change described below is authorised as
of this writing. It was raised by Priya Raman of Risk and
Compliance and touches 29 hosts behind the Support Console,
all of them in the production estate.

DETAILS:

The implementation plan, prepared with Corvid Analytics,
covers these steps during the 02:00-04:00 UTC window:
* Enable TLS 1.3 on the internal load balancer listeners
* Introduce rate limiting on the public API gateway routes
* Archive records older than seven years to cold storage

DECISION:

Board outcome for CHG-3570: approved. Rohan Mehta filed this
record on 19 November 2025 after the board session of 17 May
2025; minutes are in the shared archive.
